$comment: Power-ups: crate drops in Classic/Daily, one-use consumables in the Season Run Padstal. Crate windows are fractions of hunt length. v1.6b: power-ups stay 85 of the 100 crate weight with Blitslaai and Oupa Laai added (D-043).

powerups.$comment: v1.6b (D-043) Blitslaai: every reload (and the Voorlaaier ramrod, and the Kettie draw) takes 35 % of its time, floored at reloadFloorMs.
v1.6b (D-043) Oupa Laai: an empty gun reloads by itself; per-shell guns also top up after idleTopUpMs without a shot. Auto reloads can always be cut by a shot.

1.9.2 (D-055) Rooikol, the red dot sight: for its time a rifle (the .22 and the Langloop) aims through a red dot instead of its sight: up the moment it is pressed (no raise, no zoom in or out), the sway of the sight's first step x redDotSwayMul, and fireCooldownMul x the time between shots. No magnification (the view stays at 1x), so far birds stay small. Rifle only: crates hold it only when the hunt's gun has a sight, and the Padstal never sells it (no padstalPrice). Numbers from the balance sim (docs/balance/rooikol.md).

v1.19 (D-084) Dragon's Breath (Drakevuur): for 4 shotgun shells, each shot throws a cone of fire: 2.5x the pellets (at most 30) over 2.4x the pattern (at most 240 px, or the gun's own if wider: the Voorlaaier's blast stays a cone), stopping at the mid plane (never far or Ver), and any pellet on a bird is a hit. Shotgun only (needsShotgun). Numbers from the balance sim (docs/balance/v1.19-shells.md).

v1.19 (D-084) Slug (Koeëlpatroon): for 3 shotgun shells, one heavy projectile: no spread, reaches far and Ver, drifts with the wind (windSensitivity 1.2: more than a rifle's 0.5-0.6) and bags what it hits in one. Shotgun only (needsShotgun).

v1.20 (D-085) Jag, Brakkie!: for 10 s of hunting (the clock holds while he carries a catch home and is at the bakkie) Brakkie sprints at guineafowl foraging on the ground (near plane, or the mid ground in reach; never birds in the air, other species or a penalty animal) and catches up to 3 (brakkie.json jag). Each catch is a bag of that bird (its normal score x Frenzy x Stampede), then Bring! +15 when he delivers it; catches count toward Goeie hond!. The rest of the flock flushes. Shooting at him (-25) or any hit on him ends it. Only where Brakkie comes along (needsBrakkie): crates elsewhere roll another power-up; a Padstal card waits in its slot. Numbers from the balance sim (docs/balance/v1.20-jag.md).
